   160	 PROPOSED COMPLIANCE ORDER
   161	Pursuant to 49 United States Code § 60118, the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
   162	Administration (PHMSA) proposes to issue to Tallgrass a Compliance Order incorporating the
   163	following remedial requirements to ensure the compliance of Tallgrass with the pipeline safety
   164	regulations:
   165	A.
   166	
   167	In regard to Item Number 2 of the Notice pertaining to the failure to inspect pipe
   168	for atmospheric corrosion at its compressor station, REX must, within 90 days of
   169	the Final Order:
   170	i.
   171	Evaluate all locations in the scope of the inspection for buildings with pipe
   172	penetrating building walls that have not been inspected adequately.
   173	ii. Perform adequate visual inspection at all locations identified by the
   174	evaluation required by i and document.
   175	iii. Must develop and implement training to ensure individuals who perform
   176	atmospheric corrosion inspections have necessary knowledge and skills to
   177	perform the atmospheric corrosion inspections in a manner required by §
   178	192.481.
   179	iv. Submit revised training and records of inspection upon completion to the
   180	Director of Central Region.
